description:
Better Variants v1.5.0

git repo
download

requires variants lib 0.5.6 (download)
requires Luna Lib (optional) (topic)

Game screen shots

Spoiler

Features
Better Variants aims to make combat more challenging by adjusting the composition of AI fleets. Features include:

New and reworked ship variants in AI fleets
Smarter assignments of officers to ships and officer skills
Autofit (ie random ship variants) being disabled for most vanilla factions and fleets
Special, randomly occurring, themed fleets with unique compositions
A bar mission for fighting themed fleets
Settings which can be changed via Luna Lib or file (VariantsLib/data/variants_lib/variants_lib_settings.json and BetterVariants/data/bettervariants/better_variants_settings.json)

Some settings are found in Better Variants, others in Variants Lib
If Luna Lib is enabled, Luna Settings take precedence over the files

Version checking

Mod Compatibility
The features from this mod will not affect fleets that aren't from vanilla factions or are mission related (usually), which ensures a decent amount of mod compatibility. This mod has some special behavior with Nexerelin. Themed fleets will appear among some Nexerelin fleets including invasion and revenge fleets. Interactions with any other mods are not tested during development.

Change Log

Spoiler
1.5.0

Updated to 0.98
Adjusted some fleets, variants, and officer assignment logic
Requires VariantsLib 0.5.5 or higher to run

1.4.3

Added Luna Lib as an optional dependency for LunaSettings. If Luna Lib is not enabled, the values in BetterVariants/data/bettervariants/better_variants_settings.json are used
VariantsLib has also gotten Luna Lib as an optional dependency. If Luna Lib is not enabled, values in VariantsLib/data/variants_lib/variants_lib_settings.json are used
Added the "Harder Remnants" setting, which disables autofit for remnants, gives their officers more relevant skills, and gives them randomly occurring themed fleets
VariantsLib has also gotten a new setting called "Universal No Autofit", which disables autofit for the fleets of all factions
Fixed bugs related to variants not being deep copied before assignment
Requires VariantsLib 0.5.3 or greater to run

1.4.2

Fixed some hulls in Persean and Luddic Church fleets and markets not showing up as much as they should

1.4.1

Added back "exotic bounty" mission
Exotic bounties now offer patrol and remnant bounties in addition to deserters
Added additional challenge fleets that can be found in exotic bounty missions

1.4.0

Updated to Starsector version 0.97
Updated fleets and variants
Fixed fleets not generating with correct officer skills
Removed MagicLib dependency

1.3.0

Updated and added content for 0.96
Temporarily removed exotic bounty missions

1.2.0

Compatibility with v0.2.0 of VariantsLib

1.1.1

Fixed exotic bounty event crashing the game

1.1.0

Split off a large portion of code to a separate lib
Now requires VariantsLib
New fleet variants
Fixed s-mods not applying on AI fleets
Adjusted spawning weights to make Safety Overrides ships less common
Settings are now in data/variants_lib of the mod's folder

1.0.3

Fixed reputation gain for completing bounty

1.0.2

Fixed crash related to bar event
Adjusted bounty behaviour and rewards

1.0.1

Fixed exotic bounty bar event spawning on modded faction markets and causing crashes.
If you still see this bar event on a save that has previously been running on version 1.0.0 of this mod, don't view it and wait for it to despawn.

1.0.0

Added bar event "Talk to the officer offering exotic bounties" that gives bounties with fleet variants from this mod
Now requires MagicLib

0.2.1

Fixed modded ship spawning breaking
Tweaked variants

0.2.0

Settings JSON in data/bettervariants of mod folder
Types variants unique to task forces and Nexerelin revenge fleets
New fleet types and variants
Version checking

Features
Better Variants aims to make combat more challenging by adjusting the composition of AI fleets. Features include:

  • New and reworked ship variants in AI fleets
  • Smarter assignments of officers to ships and officer skills
  • Autofit (ie random ship variants) being disabled for most vanilla factions and fleets
  • Special, randomly occurring, themed fleets with unique compositions
  • A bar mission for fighting themed fleets
  • Settings which can be changed via Luna Lib or file (VariantsLib/data/variants_lib/variants_lib_settings.json and BetterVariants/data/bettervariants/better_variants_settings.json)

    • Some settings are found in Better Variants, others in Variants Lib
    • If Luna Lib is enabled, Luna Settings take precedence over the files
  • Version checking

Mod Compatibility
The features from this mod will not affect fleets that aren't from vanilla factions or are mission related (usually), which ensures a decent amount of mod compatibility. This mod has some special behavior with Nexerelin. Themed fleets will appear among some Nexerelin fleets including invasion and revenge fleets. Interactions with any other mods are not tested during development.
